(1) Strips Workato system fields (Record ID, Created at, Updated at) from all data table records so they do not corrupt the SQL virtual table schema.  
(2) Builds an error code → human-readable message lookup from error_translations.

(4) Performs a single pass over the payload to (a) normalize date values to ISO-8601, (b) evaluate regex patterns and emit pre-computed error rows.
